answer: Sponsor-backed admission stops fake identities in an agent economy. Each identity enters only when a sponsor stakes a vault deposit from a capped quota. Audits each epoch probe a few; proven fraud burns 30% of stake. Fraud rings leave a karst pattern in the deposit graph, easy to flag; at its nadir an identity is expelled. Cost ledger: N fakes need N deposits locked 20 epochs plus rising rent, and one slash wipes it, so cost per head climbs.
